scenes.prompt: Create a NEW original wide 3:2 editorial concept artwork for an Australian public proposal about a fair go in the age of superintelligence. Supplied images are style/concept references ONLY: draw on their characterful cinematic humanistic futurism, grounded interactions, confident purple clothing, purposeful blue technology and warm gold light. Do not copy any identifiable person, author, face, exact composition, lettering or branding from the references. Purple, electric blue and gold remain DISTINCT colours in actual garments, interfaces and materials; skin and environment have varied natural colours. NO flat purple wash, uniform tint, corporate-stock neutrality or rustic/hippie garden aesthetic. Warm timber and nature may appear as supporting context, never the main subject. Enthusiastic human agency, creativity and useful ethical technology matter. No official government, Olympic or party logos, signage or text; no clinical equipment, treatment, coercion or claims of operating services. All people fictional. Scene: a fictional young person about 12 in a characterful amethyst-purple overshirt actively directs the creation of their own imaginative adventure game on a large desktop display, pointing to a scene choice while a trusted adult facilitator in a plum jacket listens and helps them compare two explanations. Young person's agency and curiosity visibly drive the encounter. The game contains a recognisable coastal town opening toward an imaginative Earth-to-space future, small original friendly robots and pathways, with a separate panel of chosen creative records and a seven-nested horn-torus Aura motif whose rings meet at a shared central pinch; no lettering required. Show the actual screen clearly and two little physical storyboard cards on the desk, so this is purposeful learning about choices and AI rather than passive entertainment. A stowed XR headset sits beside a tablet, optional equipment not worn. Welcoming contemporary community creative studio, cream/soft-white walls, elegant timber-and-white desk, a few blue and purple materials, golden late-afternoon daylight and distant sea/urban horizon. Emotionally warm, slightly wondrous but tangible, visually rich polished cinema still. Main learner and adult remain the focal point. No bulky booth, no clinic, no demand for personal disclosure, no decorative plant-filled room.
